name: pax-bridge-desktop
description: Installable, auto-updating desktop app that runs the Salesgent PAX payment bridge on a store computer.
author: Salesgent

scripts.prepare:build: npm run icons && npm run bridge:install
scripts.create:exe: npm run prepare:build && ELECTRON_BUILDER_COMPRESSION_LEVEL=1 electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.create:all: npm run prepare:build && ELECTRON_BUILDER_COMPRESSION_LEVEL=1 electron-builder --mac dmg --win nsis
scripts.release: npm run prepare:build && ELECTRON_BUILDER_COMPRESSION_LEVEL=1 electron-builder --publish always
